## Objective
- Triage static scan of public repos from `gladiaio/` GitHub org (official Gladia org) plus npm package metadata for `@gladiaio/sdk`, scoped as MEDIUM priority within a Whale browser security research program.

## Important Details
- **Program scope**: Whale browser bugs (latest-version, must reproduce at report time); third-party libs used ONLY by Whale (not Chromium); synchronization bugs. SDK repos are MEDIUM priority.
- **Excluded**: All Naver web services (`*.naver.com`, `*.navercorp.com`), built-in extension servers (Papago, Belli), URL preview spoofing, XSS Auditor bypass, IETab, SafeBrowsing FP/FN.
- **Secrets policy**: sha256 only, never raw.
- **Current Whale version**: v4.39.410.14 (desktop), v3.9.14.9 (Android) — bumped from v4.38.386.14 on Aug 18 via same-day double release with Chromium 137→138 + login-server-error hotfix.
- **NVD gap**: 0 Whale CVEs in 2026 (28 total, latest CVE-2025-69235 @2025-12-30). `keywordSearch=whale` on `services.nvd.nist.gov` is the working query surface; `naver+whale` returns 0 (keyword quirk).
- **Binary acquisition**: `repo.whale.naver.com/stable/deb/pool/main/n/naver-whale-stable/naver-whale-stable_4.39.410.14-1_amd64.deb` confirmed accessible (HTTP 200, 166MB). All other channels (cloudfront DNS, APKMirror 403, Uptodown 410 Gone, APKPure CDN 403, pstatic 404) remain blocked. Binary is ephemeral in-sandbox (`/tmp/opencode/whale_binary/` missing after wipes).
- **Key prior binary findings**: 7+ Whale-specific sync source files in string table (`whale_sync_auth_manager.cc`, `trusted_vault_request_whale.cc`, etc.); WBC crypto layer (`wbc.cc`, `wbc_wrapper_apis.cc`, `encryptor.cc`); `utilityPrivate` API with `setSyncEncryptionKeys`/`getSyncCacheGuid`/`getPushServerURL`/`showLoginPopup`; pinned P-256 SPKI at `0x2968510`; epoch-key request signing (HMAC, domain-separated `whale:hmac:`+`v1`) but **zero response verification** (conf 70, class EPOCH-HMAC-1 alive).
- **Public repo dead**: `naver/whale-browser-developers` documentation-only (pushed 2019-09-23, 0 releases, 4 branches = 131 blobs). 0 sync/crypto source files in any public branch.
- **Sample extension** (translate branch): 5 files HTTP 200 — ALL-origin `content_scripts` + zero `sender.origin`/`sender.url`/`sender.tab` validation in `onMessage`. Class REJECTED as duplicate of fixed CVE-2025-69234/69235.
- **Sync KDF hypothesis**: confidence 65, HUMAN-gated on binary; same-day Chromium 138 double-release + login-server-error hotfix raises regression urgency.

## Work State
### Completed
- Exhaustive Whale browser security triage (2026-08-07 through 2026-08-21): all 14 original leads triaged; sidebar SOP class REJECTED (duplicate of fixed CVEs, conf 32 < 40); socket.io REJECTED (conf 38 < 40); sync KDF class ACCEPTED (conf 65, binary-gated); EPOCH-HMAC-1 class ACCEPTED (conf 70, response verification absence code-proven)
- Binary from `repo.whale.naver.com` confirmed accessible; prior recon strings extracted; REX.W LEA byte-pattern sweep method validated
- NVD gap monitor established: `services.nvd.nist.gov/rest/json/cves/2.0` with `keywordSearch=whale` (28 total, 0 in 2026)
- Full public repo enumeration: 4 branches + 5 wiki pages + README.ko.md = 0 sync/crypto source files
- Epoch-key request signing design proven via xref-exhaustive consumer confinement (EVP_DigestSign, domain-separated labels, len-CHECKed 32B global)

### Active
- **Gladiaio triage requested**: scanning `gladiaio/` GitHub org repos + `@gladiaio/sdk` npm metadata (MEDIUM priority per program scope)
- **Sync KDF verification**: confidence 65, binary extraction is the ONLY vector; repo.whale.naver.com channel live but binary is ephemeral

- NVD date-filtered queries return 404; `nvd.nist.gov/rest` Cloudflare-blocked; only `services.nvd.nist.gov` bare `keywordSearch=whale` works

name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: '${{ github.workflow }} @ ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref }}'
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  GLADIA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GLADIA_API_KEY }}

jobs:
  security:
    name: Security check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: latest
      # Generate a yarn.lock file for audit-ci to work
      - run: bun install --yarn

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v5
        with:
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Audit for JavaScript vulnerabilities
        run: bunx audit-ci@^7 --config ./audit-ci.jsonc

      - name: Audit for Python vulnerabilities
        run: bun nx run-many -t audit

  commitlint:
    name: Lint commit messages
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: latest
      - run: bun install

      - name: Validate current commit (last commit) with commitlint
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        run: npx commitlint --last --verbose

      - name: Validate PR commits with commitlint
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: npx commitlint --from ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }} --to ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }} --verbose

  check:
    name: Lint, Format and Typing Check + Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          lfs: true
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: latest
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 22
          package-manager-cache: false
      - run: bun install

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v5
        with:
          enable-cache: true
      - name: Install Python deps
        run: bun nx run-many -t sync

      - name: Run all the checks
        run: bun nx run-many -t build,test,format:check,lint:check,type:check,version:check

  check-node20:
    name: Tests with Node 20
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          lfs: true
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: latest
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 20
          package-manager-cache: false
      - run: bun install
      # Add optional dependencies for Node 20
      # because the ws package present on e2e-node-cjs is not visible to the sdk code
      - run: bun add -D ws undici

      - name: Run all the checks
        run: bun nx run-many -t test -p sdk-js,e2e-node-cjs
